title: David and Jonathan’s Plan

questions.question: Where did David flee from to meet Jonathan?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:1 (ESV): “Then David fled from Naioth in Ramah and came and said to Jonathan...”

questions.question: What feast was approaching?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:5 (ESV): “David said to Jonathan, ‘Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat...’”

questions.question: What signal involving arrows did Jonathan arrange?
options: Shoot three arrows and tell a boy where to find them
questions.correctAnswer: Shoot three arrows and tell a boy where to find them
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:20-22 (ESV): “And I will shoot three arrows... If I say to the boy, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side...’ then come... But if I say... ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go...”

questions.question: How did Saul react to David’s absence at the feast?
options: He was angry and threw a spear at Jonathan
questions.correctAnswer: He was angry and threw a spear at Jonathan
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:30, 33 (ESV): “Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan... But Saul hurled his spear at him to strike him...”

questions.question: What covenant did David and Jonathan make?
options: The Lord shall be between me and you forever
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord shall be between me and you forever
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:42 (ESV): “Then Jonathan said to David, ‘Go in peace, because we have sworn both of us in the name of the Lord...’”

questions.question: Jonathan asked David to show him the ______ of the Lord while he lived.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:14 (ESV): "If I am still alive, show me the steadfast love of the LORD, that I may not die."

questions.question: Where was David to hide?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:19 (ESV): "...remain beside the stone heap Ezel."

questions.question: How many days was the feast?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:27 (ESV): "But on the second day, the day after the new moon, David's place was empty..."

questions.question: What derogatory term did Saul call Jonathan?
options: Son of a perverse, rebellious woman
questions.correctAnswer: Son of a perverse, rebellious woman
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:30 (ESV): "...You son of a perverse, rebellious woman..."

questions.question: Did the boy know the signal?
options: No, only Jonathan and David knew
questions.correctAnswer: No, only Jonathan and David knew
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:39 (ESV): "And the boy knew nothing. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter."

questions.question: What favor did David ask Jonathan to say he granted?
options: To run to Bethlehem for a yearly sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: To run to Bethlehem for a yearly sacrifice
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:6 (ESV): "...David earnestly asked leave of me to run to Bethlehem his city, for there is a yearly sacrifice there..."

questions.question: Jonathan gave his weapons to whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:40 (ESV): "And Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy and said to him, 'Go and carry them to the city.'"

questions.question: How many times did they bow to each other?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:41 (ESV): "...and fell on his face to the ground and bowed three times..."

questions.question: Why did Saul think David was absent on the first day?
options: Something has happened to him. He is not clean.
questions.correctAnswer: Something has happened to him. He is not clean.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:26 (ESV): "Saul did not say anything that day, for he thought, 'Something has happened to him. He is not clean; surely he is not clean.'"

questions.question: Who sat beside Saul at the feast?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 20:25 (ESV): "...Jonathan sat opposite, and Abner sat by Saul's side, but David's place was empty."

key_verse_text: Then Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD...” (ESV)
